title: Parse: Extract requirements from LCI /msg/ack
description: Read spec section, extract MUST/SHALL/SHOULD statements, create checklist in task description
notes:
LCI /msg/ack Requirements Checklist (from spec/11-lci.md:201 and spec/12-apps.md:88-101):

**Protocol:**
- POST method on /msg/ack
- Content-Format: application/cbor (ct=60)
- Resource type: rt="msg.ack"

**Payload Fields (all required):**
- id (uint): message ID being acknowledged - u64 per LCI spec 17.5.7
- status (string): one of "delivered", "read", "failed"
- ts (uint): Unix timestamp

**Behavior:**
- Sent by recipient when original message had ack: true
- Sent to original sender's address

**Error Handling (implicit from CoAP):**
- 4.00 Bad Request: invalid CBOR, missing fields, wrong types

**Note:** Messaging is OPTIONAL (MAY implement), but format is normative when implemented.
close_reason: Extracted requirements from spec/11-lci.md:201 and spec/12-apps.md:88-101. Requirements documented in note: POST method, ct=60, rt=msg.ack, payload with id/status/ts fields. Existing MessageReceiptsResource already implements all requirements.
